title: Anytime Reusable Menstrual Period Cup Medical Grade Silicone
variants: Blue/Pink/Purple/Clear in Small and Large (8 variants)
description_html:
Reusable Menstrual Cup for Period Care

Disposable pads and tampons mean repeat purchases and more period waste. This reusable menstrual cup is made from medical-grade silicone and collects flow rather than absorbing it. Choose Small, which holds roughly 15 ml, or Large, which holds approximately 28–30 ml. Each cup includes a storage pouch and instruction manual.

Key Features

  • Medical-grade silicone menstrual cup.
  • Small holds roughly 15 ml; Large holds approximately 28–30 ml.
  • Use for up to eight hours before removing and cleaning.
  • Suitable for swimming and exercise when correctly inserted.
  • Reusable for a typical lifespan of 5 to 10 years with proper care.

Move away from disposable period products with a reusable menstrual cup that can be cleaned and used throughout your cycle, helping reduce repeat purchases and ongoing period waste.
